tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gshin po rjes 'dzin dang bcas pa/ 'gro kun thar par 'dren pa'i lcags kyu bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra akṣo bhyaḥ mi sogs 'gro kun skyob mdzad pa'i/ /'khrugs pa mi mnga' sku gsung thugs/ /rab ldan bla ma la btud de/ /de yi dkyil 'khor cho ga bri/ /de la 'dir rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil chog dang 'brel bar gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga bya bar 'dod pas sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni dben zhing gtsang ma'i gnas su stegs kyi khar gzhi bzang po la 'di'i dkyil 'khor ras bris zhal shar phyogs su phyogs par bkram pa'i mthar byang shar du mtshams 'dzin/ shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas rnams dang / sgos mchod byed par spro na de'i phyir/ shar du lha gcig bcas phyogs mtshams brgyad du spos me zan re re'i phyi'i/ lho nub nas shar lho'i bar la cha gsum gtor ma/ 'og tu dgos pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su sbyong stegs padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du tshe 'das kyi ming byang ngam rus bu sogs bzhag sbyangs chas rnams dang sgrub pa po rnams kyi mdun du rdor dril 'thor nas/ gos zung rnga rol dung sogs slob dpon gyi mdun bum pa dang dung chos rdor gzungs/ spyan gyi tshem sbreng pa'i dung chos su dri chu/ de'i 'bul snod ting lta bu/ bgegs skrod dang / brab sngags yungs kar/ gzhan yang me long sku phyi gshin por dbang byed na mig dar me tog 'jim kyogs sogs 'og tu dgos pa rnams bsham mo/ sbyor ba'am dngos gzhi ni bdag nyid sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa khrus byas/ grub na theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blangs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'khod do/ /mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ zhes dang so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe swāhā/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badzra shapta swāhā/ zhes pa'i mthar/ dharma ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab/ dmigs yul gtso byas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das༞ dam pa'i chos rnams༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan nyer gcig sogs brjod/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang skad cig gi rdo rje mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i thugs kar padma dang zla ba'i steng du/ hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badzra akṣo bhyaḥmaṇḍal la sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra akṣo bhyaḥmaṇḍal la sa pa ri wā re arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes sogs nas/ shapta pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig zhes sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong par bsam la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa kha zum pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog ind+ra nī la'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dwangs shing 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang ldan pa/ g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ spyan dkyus ring ba'i spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shing zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thal mo sbyar ba'i srin lag phan tshun bsnol/ mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab nas rdo rje'i rwa ltar rtse sbyar ba'i dam tshig phyag rgya dpral mgrin snying khar reg na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni nas nāntsa swāhā bar lan re brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swāhā/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod yon phul/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥde nas rang nyid la thim pas 'od du zhu ste rang gi thugs kar padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dbus su hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar du oṃ las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ lhor trāṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchod sbyin g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ nub tu hrīḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ byang du āḥlas don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras shing 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ de nas pad kor sngon 'gro'i so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra akṣo bhyaḥmaṇḍal sa pa ri wā arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ zhes sogs re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod dril gsil rol mo rnga dung sogs dang bcas pas mchod rdo rjes phyag 'tshal ba'i stengs ka dang dril bu shlau ka re re'i mthar gsil la gdangs dang bcas/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pas/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam nyid dam pa'i mchog chos can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas dpag med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med par thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gags pa med pa'i chos nyid can/

/'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas par/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yis/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog rnams stsol mdzad pa'i/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gags par yang mi 'gyur/ /e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgya che ste/ /lan cig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang / /sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstod/ snying kha'i gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dkar po g.yas bskor du 'khod pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus te sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams la thim par bsam/ mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor bsgom shes na skabs 'dir bsgom la/ na mo ratna dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka sdig pa rnams sdig pa rnams ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni sregs sregs ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa med cig med cig ni tro ṭa ni/ tra sa ni skrag par gyis skrag par gyis tra sa ni/ pra ti ha na so sor choms so sor choms pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa ram pa rā ṇi me sarba satwa bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi las gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad/ nāntsa swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab la/ bdag gi snying ga nas ye shes pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de la mchod bstod gong ltar byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab oṃ badzra sa twa sa mā ya zhes sogs rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs kyi shlau ka gcig gis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ badzra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ rang dam tshig gi nga rgyal gyis 'khor bar bsam la dkyil 'khor gyi las rnams bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung / mdun bskyed/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥkyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wā sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngon po'i lte bar bhrūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i bre phul gyi steng du gser gyi ske rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i drwa ba dang drwa phyed pa dang / dril bu dang zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i mda' yab dang /

steng du langs pa'i rin po che'i dra mig gseng ma'i pu shus bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod pa byed pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang dra bzhir zla ba phyed pa na gnas pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mo rdo rje phyed pa dang / nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta bab bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas shing / snam bu so sor rgyan dang / ba dan sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi lha rnams/ shar dkar lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba/ de'i steng du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog ind+ra nī la'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dwangs shing 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang ldan pa'i g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ spyan dkyus ring ba'i spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shing zhal 'dzum pa rab tu zhi ba dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba lha rdzas las grub pa'i dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

'dab ma brgyad la shar du shaṃ las dpal be'u shaṃ gyis mtshan pa las padma can dkar mo g.yas dpal be'u 'dzin pa/ lhor paṃ las padma paṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od ldan ma dmar mo g.yas padma 'dzin pa/ nub tu tshaṃ las gdugs tshaṃ gyis mtshan pa las mdangs ldan ma sngon mo g.yas gdugs 'dzin pa/ byang du shaṃ las dung shaṃ gyis mtshan pa las dri med ma ljang gu g.yas dung 'dzin pa/ mer tsaṃ las 'khor lo tsaṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'jigs byed ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ srin por dhwaṃ las rgyal mtshan dhwaṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnal 'byor ma sngon mo g.yas rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ rlung du kaṃ las bum pa kaṃ gis mtshan pa las dkar sham ma dmar skya g.yas bum pa 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du maṃ las gser nya maṃ gyis mtshan pa las yid gzhugs ma ljang gu g.yas gser nya 'dzin pa thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon pa dkur brten pa/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing lang tsho la bab pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zla ba la rgyab brten zhing / sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lan gsum gyis bsngags pa'i mchod yon gyi snod dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bzung la/ mdzub mo g.yab cing gdangs dang bcas pas dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra akṣo bhyaḥ e hye hiḥ zhes dang / oṃ maṅga la shrī dzarma dza swāhā e hye hi/

oṃ maṅga la padma swāhā e hye hi/ oṃ maṅga la tsha traṃ ga swāhā e hye hi/ oṃ maṅga la shaṃ ga swāhā e hye hi/ oṃ maṅga la tsakra swāhā e hye hi/ oṃ maṅga la dhwa dza swāhā e hye hi/ oṃ maṅga la ka la sha swāhā e hye hi/ oṃ maṅga la nya tsha swāhā e hye hi/ zhes brjod cing mdun du bzed zhal gyi nang du mchod yon cung zad re blug cing spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥbhighnān ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces lan gsum gyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin cing gdangs dang bcas pas/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad du gsol/ /zhes dang pad kor sngon 'gro'i mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra wā ra sarka ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes pas yon chab phul/ spro na/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /zhes dang pad kor sngon 'gro'i sku khrus gsol ba'i steng ka bya zhing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā shrī hūm̐/ zhes pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs rje'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ padma ka mā la ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas gdan dbul la/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhūppe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya waktsiitta pra ṇa me na badzra bhanda na ka ro mi zhes pas phyag bya/ gong bdag bskyed skabs dpral mgrin snying khar rig pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya de nyid bstan te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tos bha wā ya swāhā/

zhes brjod pas lha thams cad mnyes par bsam/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bstim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra akṣo bheḥmaṇḍal la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar du 'don pa bsgyur la so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya/ mthar dharmā ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo sogs nas/ sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur bar gong bzhin/ chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rje rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don sgrub myur mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan mchog ster lha mo'i gzugs/ /gsal la dwangs pa byang chub sems/ /sgrib sbyong bkra shis dgos 'dod stsol/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad la bstod/ /ces sogs ci shes pas bstod/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du so so'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer kha dog dkar po 'phros pas bdag dang dmigs yul gyis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs nas 'od zer rnams slar 'dus te lha rnams kyi thugs kar thim par bsams la lha so so la dmigs te gtso bo la gzungs ring dang / 'khor rnams la/ oṃ maṅga la shrī dzarma dza swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la padma swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la tsha traṃ ga swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la shaṃ kha swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la tsakra swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la dhwa dza swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la ka la sha swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la nya tsha swāhā/ re re nas kyang brgya rtsa re bzlas mthar thal mo sbyar te/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs/

sgos mchod yod na/ mar me la sogs pa sbar la/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥ nas/ shapta swāhā bar gong bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs bzhin bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab pa byas la/ thal mo sbyar te/ 'jig rten khams 'di dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra akṣo bhyaḥmaṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar du 'don pa bsgyur la so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya/ mthar dharmā ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pa bya/ spro na/ gos zung / oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab la 'jam pa yang ba lha re re la zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ /srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje sku thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra akṣo bhyaḥmaṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra wasṭa ya swāhā/ de nas oṃ las rin po che sna bdun sprul te nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar 'cha' zhing ngag tu/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a bar ta ya a bar ta ya hoḥ zhes brjod cing thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ 'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra akṣo bhyaḥmaṇḍal la sa pa ri wā ra tsakra ratna pū tsi te hūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di 'bul bas/ /bkres shing phongs pa rgyun bcad de/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /gong bzhin thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ tsakra'i gnas su ma ṇi ratna sogs 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar la/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/

/ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wasti ratna/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ma hā ta ratna/ /glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas/ /bla med theg par rab zhon te/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti ratna/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du bsgrod par shog /tu raṅga a shwa ratna/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur te/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad nas/ /snyems bral mchog ni thob par shog /kharṣa ratna/ zhes brjod cing pad kor so so'i phyag rgya'i mthar se gol bcas kyis dbul/ de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul ba ni/ mgon po thugs rje chen pos byin brlabs pa'i/ /dri med shin tu mdzes pa'i dpal be'u 'di/ /gang la phul ba de yis skad cig la/ /kun mkhyen ye shes nyid dang ldan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṅga la shrī dzarma pū dzi te hūm̐/ mgon po thugs rje༞ bsod nams rgyu las byung ba'i 'khor lo 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ dam pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ zhes 'byung bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṅga la tsakra pū dzi༞ mgon po thugs rje༞ 'dam skyes 'dam gyis ma gos padma 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ 'khor ba'i nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos shog /oṃ sarba༞ maṅga la padma pū dzi༞ mgon po thugs rje༞ dam chos mi nub rgyal mtshan dam pa 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ phyogs bcur chos gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par shog /oṃ sarba༞ maṅga la dhwa dza pū dzi༞ mgon po thugs rje༞ rgyan gyis spras pa'i rin chen gdugs mdzes 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ kun la skyabs kyi dam pa byed par shog

/oṃ sarba ta thā༞ maṅga la tsha traṃ ga pū dzi༞ mgon po thugs rje༞ rin chen bcud kyis gang ba'i bum pa 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ bsod nams tshogs rdzogs rgyan gyis brgyan par shog /oṃ sarba༞ maṅga la ka la sha pū dzi༞ mgon po thugs rje༞ g.yas 'khyil shin tu dkar ba'i dung chen 'di/ /gang la phul༞ smra ngan pham byed chos sgra sgrogs par shog /oṃ sarba༞ maṅga la shaṃ kha pū dzi༞ mgon po thugs rje༞ shin tu gsal ba'i mig ldan gser nya 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las sgrol bar shog /oṃ sarba༞ maṅga la nya tsha pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya med pa rnams la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas dbul/ spro na 'dod yon lnga dbul te/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyis/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra akṣo bhyaḥmaṇḍal sa pa ri wā ri rū pa ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sarba༞ shapta༞ rol chen bya/ phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang / /a kar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos༞ /bzhes shig༞ gandhe༞ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sarba༞ ra sa/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sarba༞ parṣe༞ zhes dang pad kor so so'i phyag rgya dang reg bya la gos zung mthar se gol bcas bya/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo sogs dang / chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rjes rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don sgrub lhur mdzad pa'i/

/bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i mdangs ltar kun nas gsal ba'i sku/ /mtshan dpes rab mdzes rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /rdo rje dang bcas bdud 'dul mnyam bzhag mdzad/ /mgon po mi 'khrugs sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi rnga bo che ltar rnam kun tu/ /rnam par rtog med legs bshad seng ge'i sgra/ /yan lag drug cus brgyan pa legs sgrogs pa/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes rgya mtsho yon tan nor bus gtams/ /cho 'phrul rnam par 'khrul pa'i rba rlabs can/ /srid zhi'i rlung gis rnam par mi g.yo ba/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag dang khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can la/ /sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis legs gzigs nas/ /brtse ba chen po'i thugs kyis rjes bzung la/ /sngon chad bsag pa'i sdig pa gang mchis pa/ /bag chags dang bcas rab tu sbyong ba dang / /srid dang rnam grol bde ba gang lags pa/ /dngos grub de dag bdag la stsal du gsol/ /zhes dang / lha mo rnams la/ yon tan mchog ster sogs gong bzhin bstod/ bum pa/ oṃ āḥmri ta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wā sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod/

oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces las sngags lan gsum gyis bsngags pa'i mchod yon gyi snod dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bzung la mdzub mo g.yob cing / dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /mchod pas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra akṣo bhyaḥ.e hye hi/ zhes dang oṃ mang ga la shrī dzahma dza swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la padma swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la tsha traṃ ga swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la shaṃ ga swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la tsakra swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la dhwa dza swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la ka la sha swāhā/ oṃ maṅga la nya tsha swāhā/ zhes pa rnams re re'i mthar/ e hye hi zhes brjod cing sngags so so'i mthar mdun du bzed zhal gyi nang du mchod yon cung zad re blugs shing spyan drangs/ oṃ a bighnan ta kritta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tota bha wa ya swāhā/ zhes brjod pas lha thams cad mnyes par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha rnams bum pa'i nang du byon te/ so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa zhes pa nas rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar gong bzhin dang / 'dab ma brgyad la shar du padma can dkar mo g.yas dpal be'u 'dzin pa/ lhor 'od ldan pa dmar mo g.yas padma/ nub tu mdangs ldan ma sngon mo g.yas gdugs/ byang du dri med ma ljang gu g.yas dung / mer 'jigs byed ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo/ srin por rnal 'byor ma sngon mo g.yas rgyal mtshan/ rlung du dkar sham ma dmar skya g.yas bum pa/ dbang ldan du yid gzhugs ma ljang gu g.yas gser nya 'dzin pa thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pa rang rang gi phyag mtshan thugs kar 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa dkur brten pa/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing lang tsho la bab pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/

zla ba la rgyab brten cing / sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes gsal btab la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra akṣo bhyaḥmaṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar du 'don pa bsgyur la so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya/ mthar dharma ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas par bya/ chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid las sogs shlau ka gcig dang / yon tan mchog ster shlau ka gcig gis bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song ba bum nang gi lha rnams la phog pas de rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dal gyi steng du sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar bsam la gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ gzungs ring dang lha mo brgyad kyi sngags gong mdun bskyed skabs bshad pa ltar brgya rtsa re/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes pa dang / oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥnyer gcig tsam bzlas la gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar mchod bstod bya/ thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa mā ya/ zhes sogs rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /ces bzod par gsol la/ dung chos kyi chu bum par blugs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ phyogs skyong gtor ma/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥkyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs tshul byas la/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a dya nud pan na tod/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas ci 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad thogs pa med par bsam zhing / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs par bsam/ tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu lag g.yas rdo rje g.yab cing / g.yon dril bu gsor zhing / phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /snying rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyel po che/ /lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gnod sbyin bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston cing / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ da sha dika lo ka pa la sa pā ri wā re e hye hiḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ padma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ padma ka ma la satwaṃ gyis gdan phul la/ oṃ ind+ra ye agna ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ṛ tya ya/ wa ru ṇa ya/ wa ya we/ ku we rā ya ī shwa ra ya/ uddhaṃ brahma/ su ra ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsand+ra nakṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ a te pri thi wī bhyaḥ a su re bhyaḥ nā ge ye bhyaḥ sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas dam la bzhag de nas sngar gyi sngags kyi rjes la zhes gsungs pas/ oṃ ind+ra zhes pa nas/ sa pa ri wā ra bar gong bzhin gyi mthar/ mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ gṛhṇe dam arghaṃ swāhā/ pā dyaṃ swāhā/ puṣpe swāhā/ dhu paṃ swāhā/ dī paṃ swāhā/ ghandhaṃ swāhā/ zhes pas mchod nas g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas thal mo snying ga dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas/ tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu rdor dril gsor dkrol bya zhing / dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag

/shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ /gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ rlung ste sreg kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to 'dzin/ /nor skyong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ /steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing༞ 'og gi klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ sngar gyi sngags rnams kyi mthar/ zhes gsungs pas/ oṃ ind+ra nas pa ri wā ra bar gong bzhin gyi mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi sha mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṅga ga ga na khaṃ gṛ hṇa daṃ ba lya di swāhā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul nas/ lag g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang / g.yon dril bu chig brdung bya zhing / shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang /

/dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu/ /ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /swa swa so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas su/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang / /rang gi bu mo mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bcas/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug pa bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces pas 'phrin las bcol la/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyogs pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyobs pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes pas chos kyi sbyin pa byin la/ rdo rje thugs ka dang / dril bu rgyun dkrol bya zhing / srung ma dam tshig can khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas gyi bstan pa dar zhing / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad nye bar zhi ba dang /

bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang ldan pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ khu tshur gnyis bsnol ba'i mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtog cing / oṃ da shā dika lo ka pa la sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha/ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ 'byung po dang bgegs gtor/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥkyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ oṃ a kā ro sogs gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs byas nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs par bsam zhing / tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu lag g.yas rdo rje g.yab cing / g.yon dril bu gsil zhing / lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bud med bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la/ /bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs pa ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyi/ /gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra e hye his spyan drangs padma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ arghaṃ sogs gong phyogs skyong gi skabs ltar mchod la gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ de wa/ nā ga yakṣa/ rakṣa sa/ gandharbha/ a su ra/ ga ru ṭa/ ke na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣya/ a ma nu ṣya/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga khaṃ gṛ hṇe dam bā lyā di swāhā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar dang / g.yon dril bu chig brdung bya zhing / 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang /

/dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /rin chen gling na lhag pa gang gnas dang / /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang / /mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu sil ma can na gang gnas dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang / khang stong dag dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang / /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang / /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang sum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /seṅge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dga' zhing mgu bar gyur nas su/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bzhes nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ ces pas 'phrin las bcol zhing / snga ma ltar/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /zhes pa nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /bar gyi chos kyi sbyin pa dang / rdo rje thugs ka dang / dril bu rgyun dkrol gong bzhin byas la/ lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi sogs sngar gyi phyogs skyong skabs ltar 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra gṛhṇe daṃ arghaṃ swāhā/ zhes dang / lag pa g.yas g.yon khu tshur rgyab sbyar ba'i mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtog cing / gatstsha zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ rang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs can sna tshogs rdo rje dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin par bsams la/

'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun༞ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du tshe las 'das pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la zhes sam yang na/ dmigs yul gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang gcig yud tsam 'di nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig tshar gcig dang / ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes tshar gsum brjod pas bgegs rnams gtor ma len pa'i phyir du 'ong bar bsams la/ lag g.yon khu tshur snying gar bcangs g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas la/ oṃ gung ka re gung ka re swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swāhā/ oṃ gung gung swāhā/ sarba bighnān/ gṛhṇe daṃ arghaṃ swāhā/ pā dyaṃ swāhā/ nas/ gandhe swāhā'i bar gyis mchod la/ lag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdun nas bskor zhing mthar mchog sbyin dang bcas pas se gol bya zhing / gong gi oṃ gung ka re zhes pa nas gung swāhā'i bar/ sarba bighnā/ na ma sarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥzhes pa nas/ ba lyā di swāhā zhes pa'i bar btags la lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin pas tshim par bsams la/ lag g.yas rdo rje snying kha dang / g.yon dril bu chig brdung bya zhing / gang zhig mtshan mor rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang / /srin po sha rjen za ba dang / /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa/

/de dang de la gtor ma ni/ /bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras chen 'bras bu mang po yi/ /mchod pa 'di yis mgu byos la/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid/ /de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis/ zhes bsngos la/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing / /dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste/ /dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze de/ /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/ /'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du/ /rang gi lus la dpe longs la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gi /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa/ /nad de nye bar phyungs nas su/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ /de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyi/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yis/ /dam tshig gnas la gnas nas su/ /bdag gi bsam pa bskang bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing / /'dir ni bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad de rab tu sol mdzod la/ /gdon rnams rang gi gnas su song / /zhes brjod cing / oṃ sarba bighnān gatstsha zhes pas gshegs su gsol la/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor zhing / rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing gzhan yang rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas pas/ na maḥs manta kā ya wā kka tsitta badzra ṇaṃ na mo badzra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃṣṭata ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la/ pa ri shu ba hasta ya/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hulu hu lu/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ bhandha bhandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi spho ṭa ya/ bi spho ṭa ya/ sarba bighnān bi nā ya ka nān/ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti/ dzi wi ta/ anta ka ra ya swāhā/ zhes khro bo'i sngags kyis mtshams bcad/ nye reg gi don du kha chus bshal la phyir dor/ de nas bdag 'jug len na cho ga yod pa rnams bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pas mdzad cing dbang rdzas rnams de'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i mi 'khrugs pa zhig gis gtod par bsam la/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bum chu cung zad re 'thung la/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūm̐ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la/ dbang gi 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod pas maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma phul la/ de nas me tog dang bcas pa thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyed ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /bar lan gsum/ oṃ tsakṣu bhandha wa ra ma ṇa ya hūm̐/ zhes pas gdong bcings/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes me tog phreng ba gtad/ bum chu gtor te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥces pas dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ rigs nges par bya ba'i slad du/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ zhes dris pas/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags/

/zhes lan btab/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu zhig gsal btab/ de'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa zhig par btab pa bzhin du lam ste byung bar mos la/ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ ho/ siddha badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas brtan par byas gsang bar gdams pa ni spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su rab tu zhugs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes pas gsang bar gdams/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes pas dkyil 'khor shar sgor bzhag par mgo dud tsam bya ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes dang thal mo sbyar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po zhig gsal btab ste/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas 'od zer pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig la gnyis su med par thim/

mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang de 'dra ba du ma byung ste rang gi thugs kar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par gyur/ ces rdor dril gsor dkrol rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ na mo ratna tra yā ya sogs gzung ring gi mthar/ oṃ badzra a we sha ya a ā/ zhes mang du brjod pas ye shes phab/ rol mo rnams bzhag spyi bor rdo rje bzhag pas brtan par byas par mos la/ tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes pas brtan par byas nas gong bdag mdun sogs su bshad pa'i dam rgya spyi bor bzhag ste/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni nas/ swāhā bar lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ dam pa gsol ba gdab pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas mdzad par bsams la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas gdangs dang bcas/ yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /'di yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ nam mkha'i mdog brtags la mthong snang dang mthun pa'i las 'grub par bsam/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ dkyil 'khor la me tog phul me tog de mgo bor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ pra ti gṛhṇa satwaṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes rang mgor 'bru cung zad bzhag gdong g.yogs 'grol tshur dang / rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyed kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur ba'i/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ he badzra pashyaiḥ zhes pas mig ras bsal te dkyil 'khor bltar gzhug pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyed ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba'i phun tshogs dngos grub kyang / /thams cad khyod la mngon du gyur/

/dngos grub phyir ni dam tshig srung / /gsang sngags dag la'ang brtson par gyis/ /zhes dang / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor pa dang mngon sum lta bur mjal ba yin no/ /zhes brjod/ maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dbang gi dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i don du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /thal mo sbyar la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa nas bzhugs pa bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ de'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun tu dung la sogs pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te rang rang gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / na mo ratna tra ya yā oṃ kaṃ ka ni nas/ swāhā'i rjes su/

oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag nas bdag nyid rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i skur brtan par gyur/ gong bdag mdun sogs su bshad pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tota bha ba swāhā/ zhes cod pan gyis dbang bskur nas de la/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du bdug spos nas zhal zas bar gyi sngags rgyas mchod de bya rgyud kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi'o/ /mtha' brten ni las kyi rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa dang / bkra shis kyi lha mo rnams lhan cig pas bum pa thogs te rang la khrus gsol bar mos la dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dang / oṃ maṅga la shṝ dzahma dza swāhā/ de bzhin du ji ltar bltams pa sogs gong 'og rnams su bshad pa ltar dang / oṃ maṅga la padma swāhā/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa/ /gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ maṅga la tsha traṃ ga swāhā/ 'di ni tshul khrims༞ khrims 'chal dri ma༞ tshul khrims༞ khrus legs༞ oṃ maṅga la shaṃ kha swāhā/ 'di ni bzod pa'i༞ khong khro'i༞ bzod pa༞ khrus legs༞ oṃ maṅga la tsakra swāhā/ 'di ni brtson 'grus༞ le lo'i༞ brtson 'grus༞ khrus legs༞ oṃ maṅga la dhwa dza swāhā/ 'di ni bsam gtan༞ rnam g.yeng༞ bsam gtan༞ khrus legs༞ maṅga la ka la sha swāhā/ 'di ni shes rab༞ shes 'chal༞ shes rab༞ khrus legs༞ oṃ maṅga la nya tsha swāhā/ zhes dang dril gsil bzhag ku shas chu 'thor la/ sarba pa paṃ bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ sarba bighnān༞ sarba ro ga༞ sarba duṣṭaṃn༞ sarba gra he༞ sarba dzo re༞ sarba byā dhi༞ sarba u pa dra we༞ sarba a kā la mṛ tyu/ sarba dur swab ni/ sarba dur mi ti sarba tsitta ku le bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/

zhes pas bkrus te byab pa ni/ rma bya'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsam ste/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sgros/ lus la byab pas nad rims gdon bgegs thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags len pa ltar blangs nas phyir dor bar mos te/ na mo ratna tra ya yā/ gzungs lan gcig gi mthar/ sarba pa paṃ bhyaḥ.a pa nā ya swāhā/ sarba bighnan༞ sarba ro ga༞ sarba duṣṭan༞ sarba gra he༞ sarba dzo re༞ sarba byā dhi༞ sarba u pa tra be༞ sarba a ka la mṛ ryuu༞ sarba dur swab ni༞ sarba dur mi te༞ sarba tsitta ku le bhyaḥ a pa nā ya swāhā/ zhes byas pas sdig sgrib skyugs par bsam/ bsrung ba ni/ rang gi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su rdo rjes reg pa la brten nas de las de 'dra ba'i rigs can bsam gyis mi khyab pa las byung bas lus la rdo rje'i go gyon te bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed par byas snyam du mos la/ na mo ratna tra yā ya sogs gzungs lan gcig gi mthar/ sarba pa paṃ bhyaḥrakṣa rakṣa/ sarba bighnan༞ sarba ro ga༞ sarba duṣṭan༞ sarba gra he༞ sarba dzwa re༞ sarba bhyaḥdhi༞ sarba u pa dra we༞ sarba a kā la mṛ ryu༞ sarba dur swob ni༞ sarba dur mi te༞ sarba tsitta ku le bhyaḥ rakṣa rakṣaḥ zhes spyi bo mdun rgyab dpung mgo gnyis pus mo gnyis te gnas gsum du rdo rje rgya gram bzhag pas bsrung ngo / /shis pa bya ba'i slad du bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams la bum chu gtor bar mos te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥkyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad bdag dang sems can rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ maṅga la aṣṭa bha bya hūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas gnang bar bsams la/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na/

bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir bdag dang sems can thams cad kyang me long gi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po che sa srung gis gi waṃ phyag tu phul ba nas gyur cig bar la/ gi waṃ gi rdzas la brten nas zhes bsgyur/ gi waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas/ /nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /sngon sogs gong bzhin/ zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu phul ba sogs gong bzhin la/ zho'i rdzas la brten nas sogs nas/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes rnam rtogs nas/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi gyur cig /sngon sogs༞ rtswa 'tshong bkra shis kyis rtswa dur ba phyag tu phul ba sogs gong bzhin/ dur ba'i rdzas la sogs/ dur bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel gyur cig /sngon sogs gong bzhin/ lha tshangs pas bil ba phyag tu phul ba sogs gong bzhin la/ bil ba'i rdzas la sogs la/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub gyur cig /sngon sogs༞ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag tu phul ba sogs gong bzhin/ dung dkar gyi rdzas la sogs༞ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul/

/ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /sngon sogs༞ bram ze skar rgyal gyis li khri phyag tu phul ba sogs gong bzhin la/ li khri'i rdzas la sogs༞ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus nas kyang / /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur cig /bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes yungs dkar phyag tu phul ba na/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir bdag dang sems can rnams kyang yungs dkar gyi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig yungs dkar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog bdag dang sems can rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod dbang gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom bgyi snyam pas thal mo sbyar te/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyis/ /zhes lan gsum gyis khas blangs nas/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐ sogs/ maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma rgyas pa thog ma bzhin la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dbang yongs su rdzogs pa'i gtang rag tu phul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs kyis dbul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyod la bdag ni dbul lags na/ /khyod kyi slob mar gzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis ci nus pa'i yon du dbul lo/ /de nas ming byang dri rten bcas/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nṛ las tshe las 'das pa che ge mo rang gi phung khams dang skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur par bsam/

rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang tshe 'das kyi snying ga'i nṛ las 'od zer 'phros pas tshe 'das kyi rnam shes gang na gnas pa nas bkug par bsam zhing lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas te/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun༞ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi༞ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba khams gsum skye gnas bzhi/ rigs drug gang na gnas kyang skad cig la 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭākki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum dang / rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong mdzub mo mthe'u chung rnams gshibs la bsgrengs/ mdzub mo'i tshigs bar pa bcag mnyam pa 'dra ba de'i rtse mo bzung nas drangs pa'i steng ka byed ces gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang nas gsungs pas phyag rgya de nyid dang / oṃ ṭākki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum dang / oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pa paṃ a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas/ rnam par shes pa a thung ngu'i rnam par bkug ste rten la thim pas snying gar a dkar po dri ma med pa'i gzugs su gyur par bsam/ gtor ma rten la bskor zhing / oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te zhes sogs gsum gyis zhi bas sbyangs/ ting lo dang chang bu rten la bskor zhing / rdo rje gsor la/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐/ gṛhṇa pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūm̐/ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bidyā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ brjod pa lan gsum gyi zhi drag phyed mas sbyangs la/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa dang / gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/

ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam brgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig spro na khro bo spyan 'dren nas mchod bstod kyi bar du yang kun rig sogs nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ gong ltar/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs nas/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa dang / gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i rigs gang yin pa de dag la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyong ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas/ des tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o/ /zhes dang rten la gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ oṃ sum bha ni sogs/ drag sngags mang du bzla zhing rol mo drag tu bya zhing lan gsum gyis drag pos sbyangs/ tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad kaṃ yig nag po'i rnam pas sna sgo nas 'thon te sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas til la thim/ de g.yas su me dang g.yon du chu dor bas sdig sgrib bsregs shing sbyangs par bsam/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya swāhā/ zhes brjod pas mer bsreg cing chur dor/ rten la kaṃ ka ni/ bzla zhing bye ma'am yungs kar gyis brab la/ mthar/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig ces brjod/ dkyil 'khor la me long bstan te/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam༞ sogs brjod nas/ rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/

/byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta༞ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang bas glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis khrus gsol lo/ /de nas las slob kyis/ lag pa g.yas pas sku phyis phrag pa nas blangs la/ dkyil 'khor la phyi ba'i tshul bya zhing / de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ ka ya bi shwa dha ni swāhā/ zhes pas sku phyi'o/ /de nas las slob kyis sku phyis de nyid ci bder bzhag la dkyil 'khor la khrus byas pas chu der slar yang bum pa'i nang du blugs te bzang khrus so/ /de nas ngan khrus ni ming byang la me long bstan te/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa/ /gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o/ /'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ /khrims 'chal dri ma༞ tshul khrims༞ khrus legs༞ 'di ni bzod pa'i༞ khong khro'i༞ bzod pa༞ khrus legs༞ 'di ni brtson 'grus༞ le lo'i༞ brtson 'grus༞ khrus legs༞ 'di ni bsam gtan༞ rnam g.yeng༞ bsam gtan༞ khrus legs༞ 'di ni shes rab༞ shes 'chal༞ shes rab dri༞ khrus legs༞ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ /bag chags rnams drug sbyangs nas ni/ /gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing / /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas/ /bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i/ /khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ /dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /yongs rdzogs grub nas/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni/

dril gsil rol chen bum chu bran/ bum chu 'thor ba'i steng ka dang / gzungs kyi mthar/ che ge mo'i sarba pā paṃ bhyaḥ shāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te sarba bighnan༞ sarba ro ga༞ sarba duṣṭan༞ sarba gra he༞ sarba dzwa re༞ sarba byā dhi༞ sarba u pa dra we༞ sarba a kā la mṛryu༞ sarba dur swob ni༞ sarba dur mi te༞ sarba tsitta ku le bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas bkrus tshe 'das kyis byed par bsam la/ dkon mchog gsum la nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog bar lan gsum mam/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa/ /stobs chen 'jigs pa rnam sel ba/ /tshe 'das skyabs su mchi lags so/ /de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang / /de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs su mchi/ /tshe 'das 'jigs pa cher mthong nas/ /kun tu bzang la tshe 'das 'bul/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la tshe 'das kyi/ /lus 'di bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang / /nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ /sdig ldan 'di la skyabs tu gsol/ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang / /sa yi snying po dag dang ni/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal snying nas 'o dod 'bod/ /gang zhig mthong nas gshin rje yi/ /pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams/ /skrag nas phyogs bcur 'byer byed pa/ /rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon chad khyod kyi bka' las 'das/ /da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas/ /khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi/ /'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad rjes ma lan gsum brjod nas/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du tshe las 'das pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang /

byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /sdig pa sbyong du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas brjod cing gsol ba btab par bsam mo/ /tshe 'das de rang dang chos 'brel med na dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi sdom pa 'bog par bsam la/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /de bzhin du ni bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /lan gsum brjod de skabs 'dir dbang mi bskur na byang bu bsreg pa'am mi bsregs na lam sbyang bstan bya/ dbang bskur na gong gi bdun rnam dag bzhag la ming byang la bum chus gtor te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shrī hūm̐/ maṇḍal phul bar bsam la bdag 'jug bzhin 'jug pa'i maṇḍal gsol 'debs rnams gdon/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos pa byas/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa/ bgyi ba pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon chog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs kyis rgyud dag par byas/ sngon chad rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pas mtshon byed ras yug dmar po re byin te/

oṃ tsakṣu bandha ba ra ma ra nā yā hūm̐/ zhes pas gdong bcings nas/ lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag rten gyi slad du me tog gi phreng ba re a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes pas byin nas bum chu gtor te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos pa mdzod/ rigs nges par bya ba'i slad du kyai dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ /zhes dris pas lan btab par mos te/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags/ zhes lan btab nas/ khyed rang gi snying kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu zhig gsal btab/ de'i steng du slob dpon gyis rdo rje bzhag pas rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa zhig par btab pa bzhin du lam ste byung bar mos pa mdzod/ sa ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ/ siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas brtan par byas nas/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun spyod rnams snod dang mi ldan pa'i mdun du ma smra zhig ces gsang bar gdams pa ni/spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su rab tu zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes pas gsang bar gdams nas/ slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid par mos la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo bo dud tsam dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor bzhag par mos mdzod/ ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa bdag la dbab tu gsol/

zhes gsolab btab nas/ khyed rang skad cig gis rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na rdo rje 'dzin pa dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po gcig gsal btab ste/ slob dpon la mos gus mdzad pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas 'od zer pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ khyed rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig la gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin du mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas de 'dra ba du ma byung ste khyod rang gi thugs kar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang gzungs ring gi mthar/ oṃ badzra a we sha ya aḥ.aḥ zhes pa mang du brjod/ ye shes dbab pa'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes pas brtan par byas nas/ dam rgya spyi bor bzhag ste kaṃ ka ni lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab par bsam la/ dkyil 'khor la gsol ba gdab pa ni slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor/ yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ nam mkha'i kha dog brtags pa ni/ khyod rnams kyi mig mig ras dang bcas bzhin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la gzigs te mig lam du kha dog gang mthong ba de dkar po zhi ba/

ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang / sngon po nag po mngon spyod/ ljang gu'am khra bo sna tshogs 'grub ces brjod/ dkyil 'khor la me tog dbul ba ni/ 'di nang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig nyid gdul bya 'dul ba'i ched du gtso bor gyi rnam par bstan pa tsam ma gtogs ngo bo la bzang ngan med mod/ 'on kyang las bsags pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog cig snyam pas/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes gsungs shing dkyil 'khor la me tog phul zhig ces brjod/ des kyang dbul na/ me tog de slob dpon gyis blangs nas slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste oṃ pra ti gṛhṇa satwaṃ i mam sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyed kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzod/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje mig ni bla na med/ /he badzra pa shya/ /zhes pas mig ras bsal te/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /zhes sogs gang bzhin brjod la/ de yang 'di na 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ phyi rol du me ri rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i bsrungs ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma so gnyis pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta bab bzhis mdzes shing steng thog rim pa gsum du phub pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gi lha rnams phyogs kyi mdog can gyi dbus su sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa'i padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa/ zhes sogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pas lha ngo bstan la/

mdor na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor pa dang mngon sum lta bur mjal snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa zhes sogs kyis bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin bskyed/ de'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun tu dung la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar bsam/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te khyed rang gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / kaṃ ka ni'i rjes su oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas tshe rab thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag nas bdag nyid rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i skur gyur pa brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta torbha bā swāhā/

zhes cod pan gyi dbang bskur nas/ de la oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs kyis/ mchod de bya rgyud kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi'o/ /dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal phul/ lus dang longs spyod thams cad slob dpon la phul/ cha shas nas longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas sogs brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra akṣo bhyaḥmaṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra titstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar du 'don pa bsgyur la so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthar/ dharma ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pa bya/ gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /bdud 'dul chen po phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la/ zhes pas bstod/ zas gtad byed na/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs kyis dbul/ byang bu sreg na chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du shes pa'i ngang nas 'khrul ngor snang ba'i tshe 'das kyis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal gyi bud shing thams cad bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi mes bsregs par bsams la/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes/ /tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /ye shes snang bar 'bar gyur cig /ces dang / kaṃ ka ni brjod cing sreg go /lam sbyong bstan ni/ nub gong ma rnams la mchod pa'i rjes dang / nub tha ma la byang bu bsregs pa'i rjes la bya ste/ dril bu gsil zhing me tog gtor la/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal bzhin du/ /dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba/ /dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis/ /rin chen phreng ba la dag pa/ /tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam/ /mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam/ /bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ /byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ /rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la/ /brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs nas/ /'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog

/oṃ ratne ratne ma hā ratne ratne saṃ bha we/ ratna ki ra ṇi/ ratna mā la bi shuddhe shwa dha ya sarba pa paṃ hūm̐ tra ṭa/ ces brjod cing / tshe 'das kyi rnam shes a dkar po dri ma med pa'i rnam pa can de shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i thugs kar thim par bsam la rol mo bya/ padma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar/ /srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /srid pa'i padmo las byung ba'i/ /mngon dga'i zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ padme padme padma udbha we ma hā a bhi nanāṃ gatstshantu swāhā/ zhes brjod cing rol mo bya'o/ /gshin po rjes 'dzin rgyas pa la mos na/ rtsa rigs kyi tshab kaṃ ka nis bya ba dang / lha'i mtshan bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs cho ga gzhan rnams gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi lho sgo'i skabs nas 'byung ba bzhin du byas pas rung ngo / /gong ltar yang tshe 'das kyi don du/ 'di nas nying mtshams sbyar ma thag /dag pa'i zhing khams mngon dga' ru/ /padma'i snying po dam pa la/ /brdzus te skye ba len par shog /ces sogs kyis smon lam ci shes bya zhing bdag med pa'i lta bas rgyas btab la rjes chog gi mchod pa kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs/ mtshan sngags re re bzhin sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pa 'dod don zhus la/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs dpyad 'di la nyes byas gang / /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de nyid mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gtso bor nus pa ma mchis pas/ /ma 'byor ma rnyed ma 'tshal ba/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang bgyis rnams/ /de dag thams cad bzod par mdzod/ /ces sogs kyis cho ga lhag chad kha bskang zhing / nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/

thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol lo/ /ji srid nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag du yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi yi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ya swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor la/ las kyi rjes bsdu/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mi 'khrugs rgyal po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /mi 'khrugs rgyal po khyod sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams sogs/ /khyod kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog khyod la mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs gong du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nad dang dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang / /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas dril bu bsil zhing / ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral༞ chos la phyag 'tshal༞ sems can gang༞ de dag༞ tshogs kyi dam༞ dge 'dun༞ sems can gang༞ de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /de nas rol mo dang bcas/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bde legs shog /ces dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal bar gyur cig/
